extracted.intended_audience: registered patent practitioners and attorneys seeking reinstatement before the USPTO; bar counsel and Office of Enrollment and Discipline staff
extracted.subtask_description: Evaluation of a petition for reinstatement to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office, considering the petition, an affidavit filed under 37 C.F.R. § 11.58, any response to a Show Cause request, the petitioner's supplemental actions after filing, and all record information material to eligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petition for Reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: A formal Petition for Reinstatement must be filed and received (here: received on August 31, 2023).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Office considers the filed petition as the initiating document for reinstatement proceedings; timeliness and proper filing are implied prerequisites.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58
rubrics_metrics.description: An affidavit filed in support of the Petition, submitted pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The affidavit is supporting evidence that the Office reviews when assessing eligibility for reinstatement; compliance with the cited regulation is required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Response to Show Cause request
rubrics_metrics.description: A response to any Show Cause request issued by the Office (here: response received on February 19, 2024) must be submitted and is considered.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Responses to Show Cause requests are part of the record and are weighed in the Director's determination; failure to respond could adversely affect eligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supplemental actions following filing of the petition
rubrics_metrics.description: Any actions taken by the petitioner after filing the petition that bear on fitness to practice (the petitioner's supplemental actions were reviewed).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Post-filing conduct, remedial steps, or other supplemental information can influence the Office's assessment of whether reinstatement is appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: All information in the record material to eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: The Office conducts a careful review of the petition, supporting affidavit, responses, supplemental actions, and all other information in the record material to eligibility for reinstatement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Director's decision is based on a holistic review of the administrative record; any material information in the file may be considered in determining appropriateness of reinstatement.
